messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership wit
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.
Auto sector revenue index: 79 (baseline: 100). Foot traffic and sales are somewhat down.

Zoe walked into the diner at 2:30pm on a Tuesday, sat across from Betty Kowalski, and made the direct ask — Betty said yes within four minutes. Betty had just signed up her diner with RoboRide's restaurant delivery program and was staring at a new delivery menu she had no idea how to promote online, and Zoe's timing was almost absurd in its precision. The contract is $120/month starting immediately, one post per day focused on the delivery menu and community warmth. Miguel Hernandez had separately texted Zoe with a referral — a woman named Carmen who runs a small alterations shop on Market Street and has been asking around about social media help — which arrives as the second confirmed lead in the pipeline. Zoe posted the before-and-after TikTok comparing businesses that went dark on social versus ones that stayed visible, and it received 340 views and 6 DMs by end of the tick.
